# muxt fmt leaves out a generated template when it walks a directory, as
# gofmt does not: the first line that is not blank is a template or HTML
# comment that matches Go's "Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT." convention.
# A generated template named on the command line is formatted.

muxt fmt -l .
! stdout .

! muxt fmt -l gen.gohtml gen_html.gohtml
cmp stdout want-list.txt

muxt fmt gen.gohtml
cmp stdout want-gen.gohtml

-- gen.gohtml --
{{/* Code generated by muxt. DO NOT EDIT. */}}
<ul>
<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- gen_html.gohtml --
<!-- Code generated by a tool. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<ul>
<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- pretty.gohtml --
<ul>
	<li>one</li>
</ul>
-- want-list.txt --
gen.gohtml
gen_html.gohtml
-- want-gen.gohtml --
{{/* Code generated by muxt. DO NOT EDIT. */}}
<ul>
	<li>one</li>
</ul>
